name: Tun Fatimah
bio: Born into the Bendahara’s family and brought into Mahmud’s household after the purge, Tun Fatimah has reason to ask whose name stands behind a promise.
notes: fact: Brown describes her marriage to Tun Ali, later marriage to Mahmud and the promise concerning a son of hers; Brown later records Alauddin’s designation and succession (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 159–171; chs. XXVIII–XXIX, pp. 193–195)
gameplay: Playable correspondence about patronage is fictional; the sources do not give her command of warehouses or a merchant network (people-factions.md §2)
